🌾 Gluten-free waffles, done properly

Every waffle on the menu can be made gluten-free, prepared with separate gluten-free fryers and waffle makers — one reason Waho has such a loyal following in Brisbane's coeliac community.

Good to know

Waho isn't a fully gluten-free cafe — some cabinet items, like the croissants, contain gluten. Tell the team about your needs when you order and they'll look after you.
